public_wire_requirement: Preserve Saleor-visible ID scalar/interface and Relay/global-ID behavior used by retained operations
internal_mapping: One tested codec maps opaque typed IDs to native UUIDs; database primary keys do not change merely to imitate Saleor
owner_modules: shared GraphQL adapter; owning domain SPIs
required_acceptance: encode/decode round trip; invalid type/tag/ID rejection; ownership denial; no raw UUID leakage when global IDs are expected
decision_basis: Platform UUID identity remains authoritative behind the Saleor wire contract
review_trigger: P1 primitive and every adopted entity route

public_wire_requirement: Preserve Saleor scalar wire representation and scale/range semantics for retained operations
internal_mapping: Exact decimal arithmetic and currency-aware conversion to/from platform minor-unit strings; no binary float for authoritative amounts
affected_dashboard_surfaces: product prices; channel listings; checkout; discounts/taxes; orders; refunds
required_acceptance: currency exponent and rounding tests; precision/overflow rejection; frozen checkout/order snapshots
decision_basis: Platform exact minor-unit money contract remains authoritative internally

public_wire_requirement: For retained upstream Dashboard mutations preserve Saleor payload/error fields, enums, nullability and per-field error semantics expected by each operation
internal_mapping: Map native domain validation/authorization errors into Saleor-shaped payloads; platform-only extensions may additionally use stable extensions.code
owner_modules: owning domain SPIs; shared GraphQL adapter
affected_dashboard_surfaces: all retained mutation forms and error states
required_acceptance: valid/invalid payload snapshots; field-level errors; authorization denials; no false-success payloads
decision_basis: Wire compatibility of pinned Dashboard operations takes precedence over internal error representation
review_trigger: Each mutation operation before route release

public_wire_requirement: Support authentication/session behavior required by retained Dashboard routes; unused stock Saleor auth mutations require route-specific disposition
internal_mapping: Use platform OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE and server-side RBAC/resource/provider/geographic scope; no parallel password identity store
owner_modules: identity; console; shared Dashboard auth adapter
affected_dashboard_surfaces: login/session expiry; staff and provider route guards; users and permissions
required_acceptance: PKCE; refresh/expiry; anonymous 401; CSRF/CORS; cross-role/provider denial; audit evidence
decision_basis: OIDC/PKCE is the existing platform identity authority

public_wire_requirement: Keep Saleor operation/input/output shapes for retained Dashboard translation surfaces
internal_mapping: Map supported EN/AR fields through owning domain services; reject unsupported languages explicitly unless the platform model is extended
required_acceptance: locale round trip; unsupported-language behavior; translated slug uniqueness; persisted read-back
decision_basis: The platform uses bilingual domain fields; full handling of all Saleor translation workbenches needs a domain decision

public_wire_requirement: Preserve Saleor channel arguments and output shape for retained Dashboard operations
internal_mapping: Map to actual publication, currency, pricing, tax, promotion, shipping and order-visibility context; a neighbourhood/persona/provider scope is not itself a channel
affected_dashboard_surfaces: product listings; channel listing editors; checkout/order contexts
required_acceptance: isolation across channels; price/currency/tax/discount parity; eligibility; cross-channel denial
decision_basis: A first-class commercial channel owner/model is required; neighbourhoods and personas are not channels
review_trigger: Before Channel or channel-dependent routes ship

public_wire_requirement: Preserve Saleor Order/OrderLine field semantics for retained Dashboard screens
internal_mapping: Adapt platform aggregate order and seller-specific order/delivery legs without a second order state machine
required_acceptance: mixed-seller checkout; immutable price/fee snapshot; seller isolation; partial refund; replay/idempotency; ledger reconciliation
decision_basis: Existing platform order owner and seller-split business model are authoritative

public_wire_requirement: Retain Saleor Transaction/Payment contract expected by selected Dashboard operations
internal_mapping: Delegate facade to existing PSP transaction and ledger owners; provider callbacks remain signed authoritative webhooks
required_acceptance: provider webhook replay; idempotent capture/refund; reconciliation; authorization; audit read-back
decision_basis: Single platform payment/ledger source of truth

public_wire_requirement: Expose Saleor-shaped media mutation/result behavior to retained Dashboard editors
internal_mapping: Use existing media/S3 owner with supported upload/signed-URL flow; no fake/in-memory URLs
required_acceptance: upload/sign/complete/read-back; reorder/delete; file/type/size rejection; wrong-owner denial
decision_basis: Existing platform media owner remains authoritative
review_trigger: Before product editor media controls ship

public_wire_requirement: No fake Saleor App/Plugin records; every retained operation must represent a real platform capability or be explicitly disabled/disposed
internal_mapping: Use a real extension registry and Modulith event/outbox delivery; external delivery requires signatures/retries/audit
owner_modules: console; platform extension registry; Modulith events; integration owners
required_acceptance: install/configure/disable only when implemented; signed payload; retry/replay/idempotency; secret redaction
decision_basis: The platform does not run Saleor backend or Saleor Cloud registry; extension lifecycle must be defined

public_wire_requirement: No retained Dashboard route may depend on Federation unless gateway composition is explicitly adopted
internal_mapping: Standalone Spring GraphQL server; no fake federation metadata unless architecture changes
required_acceptance: static scan finds no retained Dashboard dependency; ADR documents standalone-server scope; any dependent route is removed/disabled
decision_basis: The platform is currently a standalone server without gateway composition

public_wire_requirement: Never count platform roots as Saleor roots or replace Saleor products/productCreate/etc. with them
internal_mapping: Keep backward-compatible while existing mobile/integration consumers use them; migrate through accepted contract publication
owner_modules: marketplace-catalog; Android contract consumers; Dashboard adapter
required_acceptance: consumer inventory; telemetry/deprecation proof; compatibility gate; upstream Dashboard ops must not depend only on legacy roots

public_wire_requirement: Root names, argument shapes and the UserCountableConnection envelope match the pinned 3.23.43 contract; User.email is nullable and dateJoined is an ISO-8601 string; unowned Saleor User fields stay undeclared until an owning capability exists
internal_mapping: Bounded User projection over the identity owner: typed global IDs via the codec; isStaff=ADMIN primary role; isActive=live login identity (pseudonymization-aware; enabled-state read-back pending); userPermissions from the effective-roles union; externalReference maps to the OIDC subject of record; forward-only keyset paging with before/last/filter and unowned sort fields answering explicit classified errors
affected_dashboard_surfaces: Dashboard staff/user list and detail views; the sign-in session bootstrap read
required_acceptance: role-matrix and per-field authorization negatives; read-back by global ID, email and external reference; guessed-ID null; malformed/mistyped global-ID rejection; keyset cursor contract and explicit not-implemented boundaries
decision_basis: The identity owner remains the single source of truth behind the Saleor wire contract; type closure grows only with owned facts
review_trigger: Every Users-domain operation before its route release; the P1 gate review

public_wire_requirement: The full Saleor PermissionEnum vocabulary stays declared; granted codes render with Saleor display names
internal_mapping: SaleorPermissionCatalog maps platform roles to granted codes (ADMIN: MANAGE_STAFF/MANAGE_USERS/MANAGE_ORDERS; PROVIDER: ownership-scoped MANAGE_PRODUCTS; CONSUMER: none) and grows only with implemented operations; Saleor permission requirements are enforced as platform ADMIN at the identity use-case boundary
required_acceptance: tested role matrix incl. effective multi-role union; AUTHZ-001 denial negatives per operation
decision_basis: Server-enforced platform RBAC rendered in Saleor permission vocabulary; UI route guards are not security boundaries
review_trigger: Every wave that adds operations with Saleor permission requirements

public_wire_requirement: Preserve the Saleor Group surface (id/name/permissions) for the retained Dashboard permission-group screens
internal_mapping: The platform owns no stored group table: the group collection is the closed UserRole vocabulary; each group native handle is a deterministic name-based UUID (RFC 4122 v3) behind the typed global ID; Group.users stays undeclared until a role-to-users union owner query exists with tests
affected_dashboard_surfaces: Dashboard configuration/users permission-group list and detail
required_acceptance: role matrix negatives; read-back by global ID with same-ID stability; guessed-ID null; malformed/mistyped global-ID rejection
decision_basis: No group store exists; the closed role vocabulary is the honest bounded collection

public_wire_requirement: Root names, argument shapes and the GroupCountableConnection envelope match the pinned 3.23.43 contract
internal_mapping: Bounded Group projection over the identity owner: typed global IDs; permissions rendered from SaleorPermissionCatalog; userCanManage from the caller actual authorities; forward-only keyset paging with NAME sort and id tiebreaker; filter/before/last answer explicit classified errors
affected_dashboard_surfaces: Dashboard staff permission-group list and detail views
required_acceptance: ADMIN-enforced scroll/lookup with role-matrix and per-field authorization negatives; keyset cursor contract; explicit not-implemented boundaries
decision_basis: Identity owner stays the single source of truth behind the Saleor wire contract
review_trigger: Every Users-domain operation before its route release
